description: The integer value of factorial-base digits. The last entry is the 0! place. [2, 1, 0] is 5 and [3, 2, 1, 0] is 23. A digit in the k! place must be from 0 through k. At most 20 digits. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/factoradic-decode
